elements.text: Lack of regular inspection and overhaul of the hydraulic actuator in Cessna model 210 and 210B airplanes, which reduced opportunities to detect defects before they progressed to failure.
Absence of established inspection criteria and overhaul intervals for Cessna part number 1280501 1/-2 or Electrol part number EA1614-1/-2 hydraulic actuators.
Absence of a defined life-limit for the replacement of the specified hydraulic actuators.
Failure to issue a service bulletin with inspection and life-limit information to detect defects before they progressed to fatigue failure.
